name: pane
summary: Frames optional chrome around content with explicit scroll ownership.

agent.useWhen: A table, editor, log, or inspector needs fixed chrome and one scroll owner.
agent.avoidWhen: Content should extend normal page flow without a block-size boundary.

invariants: Body is required; header and footer are optional.
Bounded height and body scrolling are independent options; bounded heights default to body scrolling.
Neutral wrappers add no landmarks, controls, scripts, routes, or commands.
